name: Hid
source:
A famous exorcist that attends a prestigious exorcist academy. He's a true go-getter and is constantly chasing after women instead of doing his job, causing him to get into many hijinks along the way. Sadly, his luck with women doesn't reflect the effort he puts in and is completely in the dumps, causing constant "bad" experiences.

He tries to hide it, but he's also a huge geek.
